summary: Defines MIB objects for managing the Ethernet Wide Area Network (WAN) Interface Sublayer (WIS). The module extends the SONET/SDH Interface MIB and is meant to be implemented along with it. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Some Ethernet connections travel over long-distance phone company lines. This is the dial list that lets managers watch the special part that makes Ethernet fit on those lines.
